svg.title: BIOL 004 Human Anatomy, Solano Community College
svg.desc: A deep navy card. Line drawings of human tissue in cross section, in brushed gold and terra cotta: an artery showing its three tunics, a muscle belly with its fascicles and fibres, compact bone with concentric lamellae, a peripheral nerve, an epithelial sheet, alveoli, spongy bone lattice, an arterial tree and skeletal muscle striation, arranged as an open field. The course title sits over a darkened area at the left of the card.
